supersedes: none: run alongside strict-v4 (unchanged; the reported gate result). v5 is an exploratory variant requested on 2026-11-14 after the v4 smoke test: it removes only the two penetration gates so that successful insertion is judged by entry, radial error, no escape and no truncation, and reports penetration as a measured outcome among successful insertions.

fixed.geometry: assets/round_socket_exact (scripts/build_round_socket_exact.py): 32-gon base z 0-10 mm + 32 convex wall wedges z 10-40 mm whose inner faces sit at apothem 12.000 mm (inscribed bore exactly 12 mm; audit in geometry_audit.json); same meshes in both engines; peg = cylinder radius 12 mm - clearance, half-length 25 mm, mass 0.08 kg, solid-cylinder inertia
fixed.release: peg centre at (offset, 0, release_height), tilted tilt_deg about world y, at rest; 2-s drop
fixed.perturbation: peg x, y + U(+-0.05 mm); identical arrays for both engines
fixed.pass_gate: successful insertion: entered (final centre z <= 45 mm and radial <= 3 mm), final radial error <= clearance, not escaped, no contact truncation (no penetration gate)
fixed.label_source: no external binary reference; report per-cell credible-insertion rate and failure modes (gate outcome)
fixed.penetration_reporting: peak and final penetration (mm), also split into base/rim (|n_z| > 0.5) and bore-wall contacts, averaged over successful insertions and over all entered rollouts, per cell and per candidate; not used for selection

selection_rule: successful-insertion rate, then mean final radial error, then wall time (penetration excluded)
seed_rule: selection: seed0; held-out cell j: seed0 + 1000 + j

candidate_rule.rationale: unchanged from strict-v3 (MuJoCo tc >= 2*dt at every declared dt)

diagnostic_note: exploratory: every non-frozen candidate is also run on every held-out cell with the same seeds, to compare penetration across parameters; not part of the frozen-setting result
